scenario: PixzFlow was just installed into this runtime (post-install). Discover the installed workflow, record the adaptation baseline, adapt behavior to it, verify the adaptation and persist it.
setup: Fresh runtime with PixzFlow files present; no .pixz/adaptation-state.json.
expected_behavior: E1 first activation: probe reports NEW -> inventory + baseline recorded -> behavior adapted -> adaptation verified at RUNTIME-ACTIVE depth -> persisted; report distinguishes installed vs activated vs adapted.
failure_condition: Agent claims 'I have learned PixzFlow' with no adaptation evidence, or skips inventory/baseline, or treats file existence as activation.
verification: scripts/activation.py status transitions NEW -> BASELINED -> READY across separate processes; lifecycle.first-activation + lifecycle.persisted-reload pass.
